prompt: An OH proton often appears as a broad singlet. Why doesn't it couple to neighboring CH?

options.label: Rapid proton exchange averages the OH environment faster than NMR timescale resolves coupling.
The O–H bond is too weak to couple.
O–H protons are too far from CH to couple.
OH protons resonate at a frequency outside the NMR window.

explanation: OH/NH protons exchange rapidly (acid/base catalyzed) and lose J-coupling with adjacent H — hence broad singlets.
